verdict.rationale: Rootly's own docs show only narrow export paths: retrospectives can be exported as a copy to an external editor, and status-page incident data is readable as JSON through a public API. Nothing documents a bulk export of all account data. The general REST API, OpenAPI spec and MCP server are developer building blocks, and the migration guides only move data into Rootly, so none of these earn credit. Missing for 10: a documented full-account or bulk data export, the specific open formats used, export coverage for incidents, timelines, schedules, alerts and workflows, offboarding or data-portability guidance, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Many teams use a hybrid approach by drafting in the Rootly document editor and exporting a copy to their external editor of choice.
Rootly exposes a public JSON API on your status page's custom domain, allowing you to programmatically retrieve current status and incident data.
